title: User-defined draft pipeline
objective: Implement a user-defined draft concept that the engine can put through a pair use-case-gathering mode and project management mode to turn into a full ticket tree of Little Mester tickets ready for development

acceptance_criteria.text: A user-defined draft concept is supported by the engine.
A use-case-gathering mode turns a draft into scoped requirements.
A project-management mode turns scoped requirements into a ticket tree.
The output ticket tree is created through the ticket engine.
